note: Agent Pay is not AP2. Through Verifiable Intent it uses the same four mandate vct values as AP2 v0.2 on main, with aligned constraint semantics and a mandate. key prefix; both were contributed to FIDO on 2026-04-28. No live VI use inside AP2 is documented as of 2026-11-21. Mastercard and its partners have announced two live VI uses (2026-11-12 flight, 2026-11-19 coffee through Antom), both Agent Pay purchases and neither an AP2 flow. Google's 2026-11-17 statement that Gemini uses AP2 for purchases names Mastercard only for digital tokens on supported cards, not Agent Pay or VI.
Same edge pattern (RFC 9421 signature with a tag and nonce, network-hosted key directory), different tag and directory; both networks issue their own agentic tokens, which mean different products.

Indirect: Stripe Shared Payment Tokens can carry Mastercard agentic network tokens, so an ACP checkout processed by Stripe can use one. ACP itself names Mastercard only as a card brand. Separately, Mastercard is one of the three card networks among the partners of OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet (2026-11-13); as read 2026-11-21 the post names American Express, Chase, Mastercard and Visa, where the launch-day text named three, and Chase takes part as a card issuer. OpenAI presents Wallet without reference to ACP and without naming a Mastercard program; Mastercard's CEO said on 2026-10-29 that a strategic partnership with OpenAI includes the use of Agent Pay (reported).
Verifiable Intent says its credentials can travel in UCP's AP2 mandate extension (now dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate). Mastercard endorses UCP; no Agent Pay integration is documented.

Tempo, quoted in Mastercard's AP4M release of 2026-06-10, says it is working with Mastercard on Machine Payments Protocol compatibility; Mastercard makes no MPP claim itself and maintains no MPP payment method. Mastercard's 2026-10-20 brief opening AP4M Early Access says AP4M builds on x402 and names no MPP, Tempo or Stripe.

Mastercard says Agent Pay for Machines builds on x402: its 2026-10-20 brief opening AP4M Early Access describes a 402 response and signed off-chain vouchers, piloted with Cloudflare, Coinbase and Base settlement. Mastercard is a premier member of the x402 Foundation, and Coinbase's AP4M quote names x402. The card-side Agent Pay guides do not mention x402.
